# gtme vacuum

Evict expired payloads from the ADR-030 cache tier — and nothing else; facts are append-only forever (SPEC §8)

## Forms

```
gtme vacuum
```

It exits with one of the [exit codes](/reference/cli#exit-codes) every verb shares.

## Example

The first form with every optional part left out:

```
gtme vacuum
```

## Used in

- [Facts have provenance](/concepts/facts): The command that deletes expired payloads and nothing else
